glossary.title: Strata
glossary.intro: Every candidate work is in one stratum, from the seeds it cites and its year.

entries.def: The work cites a publication on SOSA/SSN of 2017 or later (a core seed).
The work cites only the earlier SSN publications (lineage seeds), published in 2018 or later.
The work cites only the earlier SSN publications (lineage seeds), published before 2018.
The work cites no seed: found by the SOSA/SSN names and namespaces in its full text.

glossary.title: Seeds
glossary.intro: The publications on SOSA/SSN whose citing works are collected (core: the publications that describe SOSA/SSN; lineage: the earlier SSN and its patterns; variant: another record of a core publication), and the text seeds, which no citation index holds and which are found by their names in the full texts.

entries.def: Semantic Sensor Network XG Final Report (2011; lineage)
The stimulus-sensor-observation ontology design pattern and its integration into the semantic sensor network ontology (2010; lineage)
The SSN ontology of the W3C semantic sensor network incubator group (2012; lineage)
Ontology for observations and sampling features, with alignments to existing models (2017; lineage)
Semantic Sensor Network Ontology (W3C Recommendation, OGC 16-079) (2017; core)
Semantic Sensor Network Ontology (HAL deposit of the W3C Recommendation) (2017; variant)
SOSA: A lightweight ontology for sensors, observations, samples, and actuators (2019; core)
SOSA: A Lightweight Ontology for Sensors, Observations, Samples, and Actuators (SSRN preprint) (2018; variant)
The modular SSN ontology: A joint W3C and OGC standard specifying the semantics of sensors, observations, sampling, and actuation (2019; core)
The Semantic Sensor Network Ontology, Revamped (2019; core)
Extensions to the Semantic Sensor Network Ontology (W3C Working Draft / Note) (2020; text seed, found by vocab-ssn-ext, Extensions to the Semantic Sensor Network Ontology…)
Semantic Sensor Network Ontology, 2023 Edition (W3C drafts) (2023; text seed, found by vocab-ssn-2023…)

glossary.title: Coders and sources of the codes
glossary.intro: Who made the codes, and from what.

entries.def: Claude Sonnet 5.5, a language model: it coded every work.
Claude Opus 5.5, a language model: it coded a subset of the works; where it did, its answers are the ones used.
Claude Opus 5.5 agents: they coded the modelling patterns, from excerpts of the full texts.
Coded from the full text of the work, without its bibliography.
Coded from the abstract only: no full text could be obtained.

glossary.title: Engagement
glossary.intro: How deeply a work engages with SOSA/SSN: one value, the deepest that applies.

entries.def: not about SOSA/SSN: the citation supports another point, or is a list of ontologies
mention: SOSA/SSN is named in the background or related work, without further use
discussion: SOSA/SSN is described, compared, evaluated or criticised
data: the work describes data (dataset, knowledge graph, stream, application) with SOSA/SSN terms
ontology reuse: an ontology imports, specialises or aligns SOSA/SSN terms
contribution: an extension, pattern, alignment or tool proposed for SOSA/SSN itself
The text does not settle it.

glossary.title: Version used
glossary.intro: The version of SOSA/SSN a work uses, as namespace IRIs and term names show it (asked for E3 to E5).

entries.def: the SSN-XG ontology: namespace purl.oclc.org/NET/ssnx/ssn
the 2017 Recommendation: namespaces www.w3.org/ns/sosa/ and www.w3.org/ns/ssn/
a term or module of the 2023 Edition
terms of several versions
neither the passages nor the full text show it

glossary.title: Modules
glossary.intro: The modules of SOSA/SSN a work uses (several values, asked for E3 to E5).

entries.def: SOSA core, observations: sosa:Observation, sosa:Sensor, sosa:observes, sosa:hasResult…
SOSA core, actuations: sosa:Actuation, sosa:Actuator, sosa:ActuatableProperty…
SOSA core, samplings: sosa:Sampling, sosa:Sample, sosa:Sampler, sosa:isSampleOf…
SSN: ssn:System, ssn:hasSubSystem, ssn:Deployment, ssn:Input, ssn:Output…
SSN System: capabilities, operating and survival ranges, deployment
2023 Edition: the common pattern of executions (sosa:Execution)
2023 Edition: collections of observations and of samples
2023 Edition: relations between samples
2023 Edition: the RDF implementation of ISO 19156:2023 (OMS)
2023 Edition: the reworked description of systems
the alignment modules: DUL, BFO, IDO, OBOE, PROV, SAREF, OGC SensorThings…

glossary.title: Result patterns
glossary.intro: How a work represents the results of observations (several values).

entries.def: a literal with sosa:hasSimpleResult
a quantity value of QUDT, OM or schema.org
a result class defined by the work
an array, matrix, table, RDF list, JSON literal or RDF Data Cube
an image, file or stream given by its IRI
a time series
a coverage
an observation or a collection as the result
no result is represented
the passages and the full text do not show it

glossary.title: Value properties
glossary.intro: The properties a work attaches to values (several values).

entries.def: a unit, with its vocabulary (QUDT, OM, a UCUM literal…)
an uncertainty
a quality, including sosa:resultQuality
phenomenon and result time, with OWL-Time or literals
no property is attached to the values
The text does not show it.

glossary.title: Error codes
glossary.intro: Errors in the use of SOSA/SSN, coded by the language model: syntactic (S), semantic (M) and structural (G).

entries.def: syntactic: wrong or mixed namespace IRI (a SOSA term in ssn:, https, missing / or #)
syntactic: a term that no version declares
syntactic: misspelt name (case, plural, typo)
semantic: domain or range violated
semantic: class used as an individual, or the converse
semantic: a term used against its definition
semantic: a deprecated or superseded term, for the version the work claims
structural: an observation, actuation or sampling without a link its pattern expects (feature of interest, property, result, procedure)
structural: a link attached to the wrong node (a result on the sensor, a property on the platform…)
structural: another departure from the patterns of the specification, described

glossary.title: Domains
glossary.intro: The application domain, from a closed, coarse list fixed before coding (asked for E2 to E5).

entries.def: Application domain: environment and earth observation.
Application domain: agriculture and food.
Application domain: buildings.
Application domain: cities and mobility.
Application domain: energy.
Application domain: manufacturing and industry.
Application domain: health.
Application domain: water and oceans.
Application domain: robotics and autonomous systems.

entries.code: generic IoT and Web of Things
entries.def: Application domain: generic IoT and Web of Things.
Application domain: science and laboratories.
Application domain: other.

glossary.title: Name classes (found by script)
glossary.intro: Each prefixed name of SOSA/SSN a full text writes (sosa:System, ssn:Observation…) is classified by a script against the terms of SSN-XG, of the 2017 Recommendation and of the 2023 Edition, knowing the namespaces the work declares and the dates at which terms entered sosa: (the Working Group decided on 2023-09-21 that every term goes into sosa:; protocol/namespace-history.toml). S1 to S3 are the matching error codes.

entries.def: A name of SOSA/SSN 2017, in its namespace.
A name of the SSN-XG ontology (2011), in its namespace.
An SSN-XG name written ssn:, in a work that shows no namespace IRI.
A term that only the 2023 Edition declares, written sosa: after it entered that namespace.
A term that only the 2023 Edition declares, in a work of the year it entered sosa:.
A term that only the 2023 Edition declares, written sosa: before it existed: a term that did not exist yet (S2).

An ssn: term of 2017 written sosa: (sosa:System) by a work published before 2023-09-21, when the Working Group decided that every term goes into sosa:: a wrong namespace (S1), not an anticipation of the 2023 Edition.
An ssn: term of 2017 written sosa: by a work published in the year of the decision of 2023-09-21 (every term goes into sosa:).
An ssn: term of 2017 written sosa: by a work published after the decision of 2023-09-21: the 2023 name of the term.
A term of the SSN System module written sosa:, a namespace it never entered.
A SOSA term written ssn: (ssn:Observation for sosa:Observation) by a work that declares the 2017 namespaces (S1).
A term of the SSN System module (ssn-system:) written ssn: (S1).
A sosa: term written with the prefix of the SSN System module (S1).
An SSN-XG term written sosa: (sosa:SensingDevice): a wrong namespace or a term that does not exist (S1 or S2).
A term of the Extensions to SSN written ssn-ext:, whereas the Extensions put their terms in sosa: (S1).
A declared name with another case (sosa:observedproperty): a misspelling (S3).
A declared name written in the plural (sosa:Observations).
A name one or two letters away from a declared name (S3).
A name that no version declares (sosa:hasUnit): S2.
An IRI of the work's own minted below a SOSA/SSN namespace (http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/sensor/1).
The namespace written with a hash (http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa#), whereas the 2017 namespaces end with a slash.

glossary.title: Simple-result forms (found by script)
glossary.intro: The form of each value that follows sosa:hasSimpleResult in a full text (Turtle, N-Triples, JSON-LD, RDF/XML, a rule or a figure caption). A work counts once per form it shows.

entries.def: A number without quotes or datatype (in Turtle, an xsd:integer, xsd:decimal or xsd:double).
A literal of another custom datatype of the cdt: vocabulary (cdt:temperature…).
A literal of the UCUM custom datatype, value and unit together ("22 Cel"^^cdt:ucum).
A literal of the UCUM custom datatype, value and unit together ("22 Cel"^^cdt:ucum), its datatype IRI cut by the text extraction.
A quoted string with no datatype.
A quoted string with no datatype and the unit inside it ("22 °C").
A SPARQL variable: the text shows a query, with no datatype.
A literal of datatype rdfs:Literal, the unit written inside the value.
A literal of datatype xsd:decimal.
A literal of datatype xsd:float.
A literal of datatype xsd:int.
A literal of datatype xsd:integer.
A literal of datatype xsd:string.

glossary.title: Modelling pattern: Property individuals
glossary.intro: What the objects of sosa:observedProperty, sosa:actsOnProperty and hasProperty stand for (one value).

entries.def: One individual per kind of property, shared by all the features of interest (ex:Temperature observed on many rooms).
One individual per feature of interest: the temperature of room 1 is not that of room 2 (<office/1/temperature>).
Both: feature-specific properties linked to a generic kind of property.
The property is an OWL class and nothing else: a subclass of sosa:ObservableProperty, and observations point to the class.
The excerpts show no property individual or class.

glossary.title: Modelling pattern: Property source
glossary.intro: Where the properties come from (several values).

entries.def: The work defines subclasses of sosa:ObservableProperty, sosa:ActuatableProperty or ssn:Property.
The work names its own property individuals, with no catalogue.
The properties come from an external vocabulary: QUDT quantity kinds, SWEET, ENVO, OM, I-ADOPT, SAREF, CF standard names, Wikidata…
The excerpts do not show where the properties come from.

glossary.title: Modelling pattern: Punning
glossary.intro: Whether the same IRI is used both as a class and as an individual, which the specification says one should not do (one value).

entries.def: The same IRI is a class (a subclass of a SOSA/SSN class, or the object of rdf:type) and an individual (the object of observedProperty, madeBySensor…).
Classes and individuals are shown, and they are distinct.
The excerpts do not show both classes and individuals.

glossary.title: Modelling pattern: System individuals
glossary.intro: What the instances of sosa:Sensor, sosa:Actuator, sosa:Sampler, ssn:System and sosa:Platform stand for (one value).

entries.def: Each individual is one physical or software device (a serial number, :DHT22_kitchen).
An individual stands for a model or kind of device, shared by the observations of many devices (:DHT22 as the sensor of every reading).
Device models or kinds are classes (subclasses of sosa:Sensor or ssn:System) and the devices are their instances, as the 2023 Edition recommends.
The excerpts show no system individual.

glossary.title: Modelling pattern: Result form
glossary.intro: How the value of an observation is written (several values).

entries.def: A literal with sosa:hasSimpleResult.
A QUDT quantity value (qudt:QuantityValue, qudt:numericValue).
An OM measure (om:Measure, om:Point).
A schema.org quantitative value (schema:QuantitativeValue).
A result node (sosa:Result or a class of the work) with the work's own value property.
The value hangs on the observation by a property of the work other than hasSimpleResult (:hasValue).
An array, a matrix, a JSON or CSV literal, an RDF list or a Data Cube.
A file, an image or a stream given by its IRI.
An observation or a collection as the result.
The excerpts show no result.

glossary.title: Modelling pattern: Unit placement
glossary.intro: Where the unit of a value is written (several values).

entries.def: In the literal: a cdt:ucum or other custom datatype, or a string with the unit ("22 °C").
On the result node (qudt:unit, qudt:hasUnit, om:hasUnit, schema:unitCode).
On the observation, by a unit property.
On the observed property or its class.
On the sensor or on a collection of observations.
Values are shown without any unit.
The excerpts show no value.

glossary.title: Modelling pattern: Time
glossary.intro: How the time of an observation is written (several values).

entries.def: sosa:resultTime with an xsd:dateTime literal.
sosa:phenomenonTime pointing to an OWL-Time instant or interval.
sosa:phenomenonTime with a literal.
A timestamp property of the work or of another vocabulary.
An observation whose phenomenon time is after its result time: the forecast pattern of the specification.
The observations shown have no time.
The excerpts show no observation time.

glossary.title: Modelling pattern: Hosting
glossary.intro: How systems are hosted and deployed (several values).

entries.def: Platforms host systems (sosa:hosts, sosa:isHostedBy).
Deployments (ssn:Deployment, ssn:deployedSystem, ssn:deployedOnPlatform).
Systems have subsystems (ssn:hasSubSystem).
Systems are described but never hosted.
The excerpts show no system.

glossary.title: Modelling pattern: Location
glossary.intro: What the location is attached to, and how it is encoded (several values).

entries.def: Attached to the sensor or the actuator.
Attached to the platform.
Attached to the feature of interest.
Attached to the observation.
Encoded with GeoSPARQL (geo:hasGeometry, a WKT literal).
Encoded with W3C Basic Geo (geo:lat, geo:long).
Encoded with schema.org.
Encoded with a property of the work.
The excerpts show no location.

glossary.title: Modelling pattern: Grouping
glossary.intro: How observations are grouped (several values).

entries.def: Each reading is one observation.
An ObservationCollection of the Extensions to SSN, written ssn-ext:.
A sosa:ObservationCollection.
A class or property of the work, a named graph or a Data Cube slice.
A whole series as one literal or one file.
An RDF stream of observations.
The excerpts show no group of observations.

glossary.title: Modelling pattern: Feature typing
glossary.intro: How features of interest are typed (one value).

entries.def: Individuals typed sosa:FeatureOfInterest.
Domain classes declared subclasses of sosa:FeatureOfInterest.
Features typed only by domain classes, linked by hasFeatureOfInterest.
Both: individuals typed sosa:FeatureOfInterest and domain subclasses of it.
The excerpts show no feature of interest.
